claims.claim: The item is a center table and TV console.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a wall-mounted flat-screen TV on a built-in wooden cabinet/wood panel; no center table is shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show any evidence of opening/repair status.
Witness report shows only the TV/cabinet appearance; no temperature/usage test is shown.
No ports/inputs are shown or tested in the witness report.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No accessories or receipt are shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: TV brand/model and screen size are not readable, so value is uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the TV brand/model label and the screen size (or the model number on the back/side).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic wall-mounted TV console setup with unknown TV specs (worst-case: lower-spec/older TV).

risks.risk: Screen condition (scratches, dead pixels, burn-in) is not verifiable because the screen appears dark and no test image is shown.
risks.proof: A video clip powering on the TV showing a bright menu/test screen (full screen colors) and a close-up of the screen surface at an angle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially imperfect/untested screen (worst-case: screen issues).

risks.risk: Whether the TV is included vs only the cabinet is unclear from the report.
risks.proof: A photo showing the TV clearly with a visible power indicator and/or the TV connected to power with the screen on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cabinet/console only (worst-case: TV not included).

risks.risk: Cabinet condition (dents, warping, loose panels/doors) is not detailed.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cabinet edges, hinges/doors (if any), and corners showing no damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cabinet with possible wear/damage (worst-case: cosmetic damage).

risks.risk: Accessories and installation hardware may be missing (remote, cables, mounting brackets, pads).
risks.proof: A photo/video showing all included items laid out (remote, power cable, HDMI/USB cables if any, mounting brackets, pads) and a receipt copy if claimed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing accessories/hardware (worst-case: buyer must source mounting/remote/cables).

risks.risk: Ports may not work even if the TV looks intact.
risks.proof: A short video showing HDMI/USB ports in use (e.g., phone screen via HDMI or USB playback) with the TV displaying output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports untested (worst-case: some ports not working).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the TV brand/model label (back/side) and the screen size.
Send a video of the TV powered on showing a menu/test screen (colors) and confirm no dead pixels/burn-in.
Confirm whether the TV is included (photo with TV on and power indicator visible).
Send close-up photos of the cabinet for dents/warping and any doors/hinges functionality.
List and show all accessories: remote, power cable, HDMI/USB cables (if any), mounting brackets, and the claimed pads.
Show a quick test of ports (HDMI/USB) working with a phone/USB drive.
response.reason: The witness confirms a wall-mounted TV on a built-in cabinet, but key pricing drivers (TV model/size, screen condition, whether TV is included, and port/accessory functionality) are not verifiable from the report. Without those, a safe worst-case price cannot be set.
